senses.gloss: m. (πάρδαλις, pardalis; πάρδος, pardus; prob. of Semit. orig.; cmp. b. h. בְּרֻדִּים) a spotted beast, whence
(v. Sm. Ant. s. vv.) leopard or hyena, usu. in connection with נָמֵר.
(prob.) marten, or mariput (Rashi: putois); usu. in connection with חוּלְדָּה.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 9b">Pes. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 15b">Nidd. 15ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 42a">Ab. Zar. 42ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:13">Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 13</cite> ed. Zuck. <cite ref="B01184"><he>ברדלה</he></cite>.
